name: SHELF
summary: Everything you have made, as a shelf you can browse by motion. Each card is one spec: the effect plays as a looping preview, names the footage that produced it, and hands itself back to SCANNER on one click — on its own footage or on somebody else's.

surface.hint: browse saved effects as moving previews, then rerun any of them on any clip

_roots_note: Optional and honest about it: with nothing bound there is no workspace, and the surface says so rather than showing an empty shelf that looks like you have made nothing.
_calls_note: /api/effects/drive is how a card gets recreated: the shelf does not render anything itself, it hands the spec to SCANNER. Optional because the shelf is still worth reading with no scanner surface open — you can copy the spec instead.

provider._note: No new provider. A workspace is a folder of specs the effects provider already owns, so the shelf is a second READING of it rather than a second copy.
